QuestInfo.name: Icarus and the Balloon
QuestInfo.0: I wonder how #p407#'s doing with the hang glider... Maybe I should go check up on him in #m10003000#.
QuestInfo.1: #p407# failed to build a working hang glider, and, persistent in his never-ending quest for flight, is now attempting to create a flying balloon. This seems just as preposterous as his last idea, but I don't think I can stop him, so I might as well help him. To make the flying balloon, he needs #b50 #t4000028#s#k and #b10 #t4031078#es#k. For his sake, I really hope this works...
QuestInfo.2: I got the materials needed for #p407# to make a flying balloon and realize his dream of flying. I don't know if his 'flying balloon' will actually fly, but there's a chance that it might work. I'll check up on him around when the flying balloon should be ready to take flight and see if he's for real this time.

0.0: Hey, you're the one that got me the materials for the hang glider...\r\n#L0# #bDid you make the hang glider?#k#l
0.1: Oh, that... well... I faced MINOR, I mean, MIIINOR technical difficulties, and... Well, don't worry about it! #p407# does NOT let MINOR obstacles like this affect him! Anyway, I was thinking of a safer and more reliable way to fly, and I think I have a great plan. Are you willing to help me out again?

yes.0: I knew you'd help! We'll make the best flying balloon in the world! It should consist of a huge balloon, with a basket at the bottom that's big enough to fit both of us. To make it, I'll need #b50 #t4000028#s#k for the huge balloon, and #b10 #t4031078#es#k for the sandbags. We'll use those to keep the balloon balanced.
yes.1: I have the basket ready. As for the #t4031078#es, they're made exclusively out of #r#o29##k skin, and you can get them by hunting the #r#o29#s#k in the swamp. Good luck!

no.0: Trust me, we really will fly this time! Wouldn't it stink to give it up NOW, when we're so close?

0.1: You're just like everyone else, living in a box. Wake up, think OUTSIDE the box! You'll see... You'll see me flying around here some day.

1.0: I've been working on the basket, to see if it's sturdy enough to hold both of us. Now, all we need is a big balloon. Did you gather up the materials I asked you for?

yes.0: Wow, that's a lot of stuff!! Well, I'll have to get started on making the balloon. Please drop by sometime later; I should be done by then. We'll be floating our way to Ossyria in no time!

item.0: Did you get all the materials I asked for? I don't think you have all of them! Please gather #b50 #t4000028#s#k and #b10 #t4031078#es#k for me. You can get #b#t4031078#es#k from #r#o29#s#k. Please hurry. The faster you get them for me, the faster we'll be floating up in the air!
